tools.name: get_recent_listings
tools.description: The newest adverts on Trailersite, up to 20, optionally in one section or under a price.

tools.description: The sections of Trailersite, how many adverts each has for sale now, and a link to each.

tools.name: list_makes
tools.description: Makes with adverts for sale on Trailersite now and how many each has, most first. Optionally one section, or makes containing some text.

tools.name: get_price_range
tools.description: The price range of comparable Trailersite adverts for a trailer or caravan: the low, middle and high price and the adverts it came from, including ones that have sold. tools.name: search
tools.description: Deep-research search of Trailersite adverts for sale. Returns ids, titles and links; pass an id to fetch. Prefer search_trailers for filtered results.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Deep-research fetch of one Trailersite advert by the id search returned.

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: The signed-in user's own Trailersite adverts, newest first: drafts, live and sold, each with its price, views, saves and advert link. Needs the user to connect their Trailersite account.

tools.name: get_my_enquiries
tools.description: Messages buyers have sent about the signed-in user's Trailersite adverts, newest first: each enquiry's id, the advert, the buyer's latest message, the unread count and whether the seller has replied. respond_to_enquiry answers one by its id. Needs the user to connect their Trailersite account.

tools.name: get_my_messages
tools.description: The signed-in user's message threads with Trailersite sellers, and the sellers' replies. With no threadId it lists the threads; with one it returns that thread's messages. Enquiries sent with make_enquiry appear here. Needs the user to connect their Trailersite account.

tools.description: Send the seller's reply to a buyer who messaged about one of the signed-in user's Trailersite adverts. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_enquiries, get_my_messages · Private data: get_listing_detail · Public sink: respond_to_enquiry, make_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_enquiries, get_my_messages · Private data: get_listing_detail · Public sink: respond_to_enquiry, make_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
